name: Zohar canyon (barak9177, CC BY 4.0), SuperSplat collider, rescaled x8, scan hollows sealed, flight volume over captured ground
notes: Generated by sim/tools/maps/build_splat_map.mjs --scene canyon-v5b from the SuperSplat v1.1 collider ("Zohar Riverbad, Dead sea, Israel" by barak9177 (https://superspl.at/scene/7aa4d3d4), licensed under CC BY 4.0.). Occupancy is conservative at 0.4 units. Cells more than 8 units above the surrounding terrain are sealed as an altitude geofence (a flight rule, not scanned geometry). Scene units x8, treated as metres: chosen by eye with a correctly scaled drone in a lower channel; there the narrowest pinch is about 6 m. The collider's native 0.05-unit voxels become 0.4 m, so the grid cell is 0.4. The crop top (y = 20, the earlier 2.5-unit ceiling x8) is the altitude limit that seals the plateaus. Not independently calibrated.

ground.meaning: floor of each column's sky-facing free interval (null = sealed column)

config.name: Zohar canyon (barak9177, CC BY 4.0), SuperSplat collider, rescaled x8, scan hollows sealed, flight volume over captured ground
config.unitsNote: Scene units x8, treated as metres: chosen by eye with a correctly scaled drone in a lower channel; there the narrowest pinch is about 6 m. The collider's native 0.05-unit voxels become 0.4 m, so the grid cell is 0.4. The crop top (y = 20, the earlier 2.5-unit ceiling x8) is the altitude limit that seals the plateaus. Not independently calibrated.
config.scaleNote: Amendment 2: x4 -> x8 at Sujay's visual choice; whole canyon, same ceiling rule scaled.
config.hollowNote: v5: free cells more than 3 m below the floor of their column's topmost free interval are sealed. These are closed pockets under the real canyon floor (missed surfaces in the scan); v4 placed 28 of 48 canyon test hikers in them.
config.floorNote: v5: the splat has essentially no points below y = -1.5 scan units (-12 m at x8) anywhere in the canyon (0.0% of opaque points vs 2.5% at -1.5 and 33.6% at -1.0), so the collider's open space below -12 m is uncaptured void and is sealed.
config.aglNote: v5b: the drone may fly at most 8 m above the terrain (lowest ground within terrainRadius). The canyon scan is rich near the floor and thin near the rim, so flights stay where it is rich.
config.volumeNote: v5b (2026-11-19): only columns over ground the scan captured, proposed by sim/tools/env/suggest_volume.mjs canyon5 --agl 8 --close 2 --margin 0.8 (6,056 of 8,812 m2 of open-sky ground). Preview: sim/environments/reports/volume-canyon-v5b.html. Approved by Sujay on 2026-11-19.
